result.rationale: BlackRock Real Assets closed its purchase from Vision Ridge on 2022-07-20 and identified Vanguard as a GEPIF III investment. BlackRock's 2024 GIP acquisition changed platform branding, but no Vanguard-specific transfer or new GIP entry was disclosed. Merge the BlackRock/GIP identities, retain the legacy fund attribution and remove the duplicate BlackRock owner row.

identityResolution.boundary: Parent RNG/organics platform; business lines, facilities, JVs and bolt-ons are not separate parent PortCos.

ownershipResolution.attribution: Keep BlackRock as 2022 manager and GEPIF III as fund; GIP/BlackRock is current branding, not a new owner period.

currentOwners.fund: Global Energy & Power Infrastructure Fund III (GEPIF III)

operatingResolution.profile: U.S. energy/environmental infrastructure platform that processes food waste and owns/operates farm digesters and RNG upgrading systems for farms, food companies and energy buyers.
operatingResolution.footprintScale: Operates in the Northeast, Midwest and Southeast with nationwide development. Reported 17 facilities, about 260 staff and >440 GWh/year in 2024; three 2026 JV facilities total nearly 870,000 MMBtu/year.

acquisitionExitCheck.entry: BlackRock acquisition closed 2022-07-20; Vision Ridge exited.
acquisitionExitCheck.result: No disclosed parent sale, exit, transfer, recapitalization, merger, bankruptcy or pending sponsor exit found; 2026 materials still identify Vanguard as GIP, part of BlackRock.
